lesson_name: How diseases spread and were treated

photos.subject: A crowded, dirty court or street in Victorian London where poor families lived, as a picture made at the time (an engraving or drawing from about 1840 to 1875), with a modern illustration only as second best
photos.pedagogical_constraint: Children look at it while the teacher describes how crowded and dirty the houses and yards were.
photos.teaching_requirement: Picture the crowded, dirty streets of Victorian London where cholera spread.
load_bearing_evidence: a dirty yard or narrow street
photos.fallback_note: If made, it is an artist's picture of a Victorian street, not a picture from the time.

generation_prompt.physical_state: A crowded courtyard in Victorian London around 1850: tall run-down houses close together, rubbish in the yard, poorly dressed adults and children.
generation_prompt.text_rule: no readable text, labels, logos or branding
generation_prompt.composition: A drawing or engraving-style picture, landscape, showing the whole crowded yard.

photos.subject: A street water pump in Victorian times with people or children fetching water in buckets or jugs, as a picture made at the time (an engraving, drawing or early photograph), with a modern illustration only as second best
photos.pedagogical_constraint: Shows how families got water: from a pump with a handle in the street, not a tap at home.
photos.teaching_requirement: Picture families, often children, fetching water from a street pump by working its handle.
load_bearing_evidence: a hand pump with a handle in a street
people filling buckets or jugs at it
photos.fallback_note: If made, it is an artist's picture of a Victorian street pump, not a picture from the time.

generation_prompt.physical_state: A cast-iron hand pump with a long handle in a Victorian London street; a child pushes the handle while another holds a bucket under the spout.
generation_prompt.text_rule: no readable text, labels, logos or branding
generation_prompt.composition: A drawing or engraving-style picture, landscape, pump and children clearly visible.

photos.subject: A person very ill in bed in Victorian times, being looked after, as a picture made at the time (an engraving or drawing), with a modern illustration only as second best
photos.pedagogical_constraint: Shows what being very ill with a disease looked like; calm and suitable for Year 4, with nothing frightening.
photos.teaching_requirement: See that cholera made people very ill; also the picture for the word disease.
load_bearing_evidence: a person lying ill in bed
photos.fallback_note: If made, it is an artist's picture of an ill person in Victorian times.

generation_prompt.physical_state: A Victorian room: an adult lies ill in a simple bed, pale and tired, while a woman sits beside them holding a cup.
generation_prompt.text_rule: no readable text, labels, logos or branding
generation_prompt.composition: A drawing or engraving-style picture, landscape, the bed and both people visible.

photos.subject: Tar or a barrel of tar burning in a Victorian street to clean the air during a cholera outbreak, giving thick black smoke, as a picture made at the time (an engraving or drawing), with a modern illustration only as second best
photos.pedagogical_constraint: Shows what Victorians did because they blamed bad air: burning tar to make thick smoke in the street.
photos.teaching_requirement: Picture people burning tar in the street because they thought the smoke would clean the air.
load_bearing_evidence: a fire or barrel burning in a street
photos.fallback_note: If made, it is an artist's picture of tar burning in a Victorian street, not a picture from the time.

generation_prompt.physical_state: A Victorian London street around 1850: a barrel of tar burns on the ground with thick black smoke rising between the houses, and a few people stand nearby.
generation_prompt.text_rule: no readable text, labels, logos or branding
generation_prompt.composition: A drawing or engraving-style picture, landscape, the burning barrel and its smoke in the middle.

photos.subject: Portrait of Dr John Snow, the London doctor, from the 1850s
photos.pedagogical_constraint: This is John Snow, the real doctor the lesson is about.
photos.teaching_requirement: Recognise John Snow as a real person, a London doctor in 1854.
load_bearing_evidence: a recognisable portrait of John Snow
photos.fallback_note: A made portrait would be a lie about what the real John Snow looked like.

photos.subject: John Snow's original 1854 map of cholera deaths around Broad Street, Soho, London, with the deaths shown as small black marks and the Broad Street pump marked
photos.pedagogical_constraint: Children find from it where most of the deaths crowded, so the black marks round the Broad Street pump must be clear at slide size.
photos.teaching_requirement: See that most of the deaths were packed round one water pump on Broad Street.
load_bearing_evidence: the street plan of Soho around Broad Street
small black marks for the people who died
the marks crowded round the Broad Street pump
the pump marked on the map
photos.fallback_note: A made map would be a fake of the real source the class reads the deaths from.

photos.subject: The copy of the Broad Street water pump kept without a handle in Broadwick Street, Soho, London, today, or another old black cast-iron street pump with its handle removed
photos.pedagogical_constraint: The missing handle is what children notice, so the pump must clearly have no handle.
photos.teaching_requirement: See that with no handle nobody could get water out of the pump.
load_bearing_evidence: an old black cast-iron street pump
photos.fallback_note: If made, it is a picture of an old street pump with no handle, not the real Soho pump.

generation_prompt.physical_state: An old black cast-iron street water pump standing on a pavement, with a spout but no handle, where the handle has been taken off.
generation_prompt.text_rule: no readable text, labels, logos or branding
generation_prompt.composition: A clear photograph-style picture, the whole pump in the middle of the frame.

photos.subject: A nurse or carer helping an ill adult in bed to drink from a cup, today
photos.pedagogical_constraint: Shows treatment as care that helps an ill person get better; calm and kind, with nothing frightening.
photos.teaching_requirement: Picture treatment: helping an ill person get better, here by giving them a drink.
load_bearing_evidence: an ill adult in bed or a chair
a nurse or carer helping them drink from a cup

generation_prompt.physical_state: A nurse in a plain uniform gently holds a cup while an ill adult sitting up in a hospital bed drinks from it.
generation_prompt.text_rule: no readable text, labels, logos or branding
generation_prompt.composition: A clear photograph-style picture, landscape, both people and the cup visible.
